objectives:
Objective 1:	To acquaint you with mathematical knowledge, modeling techniques and solution algorithms which often serve as an aid to managerial decision-making.
Objective 2:	To develop your expertise in using and solving management science problems with the help of a personal computer.
Objective 3:	To give you experience in analyzing results and making decisions through assigned homework exercises and performing case analyses in class.
content:
1. Functions and Graphs

2. Mathematics of Finance

3. System of Linear Equations

4. Linear Algebra

5. Linear Inequalities

6. Linear Programming

7. Modeling and Applications of LP
books:
Finite Mathematics for Business, Economics, Life Sciences, and Social Sciences, 14th edition (Global Edition), by Raymond A. Barnett, Merritt Ziegler, Karl E. Byleen, and Christopher J. Stocker, Pearson, 2019

Introduction to Management Science and Business Analytics: A Modeling and Case Studies Approach with Spreadsheets, 6th Edition(international version), Frederick Hillier and Mark Hillier, McGraw Hill, 2019
